instruction:
You are a facade access and structural engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-09 envelope access, maintenance, and safety package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Envelope access, maintenance loading, wind exposure, fall-arrest, and tolerance workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse real access drawings, validate a safety certification, or prove authority approval.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-09-LH-03`
- Access plan: `ACCESS-09-PLAN-03`
- Maintenance load schedule: `LOAD-09-MAINT-03`
- Weather criterion: `WIND-09-WEATHER-03`
- Access anchor schedule: `ANCH-09-ACCESS-03`
- Maintenance operations note: `OPS-09-MAINT-03`
- Maintenance safety memo: `MEMO-09-SAFETY-03`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Access platform area | {{ access_platform_area_m2 }} m2 |
| Maintenance live load | {{ maintenance_live_load_kpa }} kPa |
| Access support capacity | {{ access_support_capacity_kn }} kN |
| Wind pressure | {{ wind_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Wind screen area | {{ wind_screen_area_m2 }} m2 |
| Wind anchor capacity | {{ wind_anchor_capacity_kn }} kN |
| Fall-arrest user count | {{ fall_arrest_user_count }} |
| Fall-arrest load per user | {{ fall_arrest_load_kn_per_user }} kN |
| Fall-arrest anchor capacity | {{ fall_arrest_anchor_capacity_kn }} kN |
| Access clear width | {{ access_clear_width_m }} m |
| Required access width | {{ required_access_width_m }} m |
| Measured tolerance gap | {{ measured_tolerance_gap_mm }} mm |
| Allowable tolerance gap | {{ allowable_tolerance_gap_mm }} mm |

## Checks

- Maintenance live load equals platform area times live load.
- Wind screen load equals wind pressure times exposed screen area.
- Fall-arrest demand equals user count times load per user.
- Access width margin equals clear width minus required width.
- Tolerance margin equals allowable gap minus measured gap.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, safety certification validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "maintenance_live_load_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "maintenance_load_margin_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "wind_screen_load_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "wind_anchor_margin_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "fall_arrest_demand_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "fall_arrest_margin_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "access_width_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "tolerance_margin_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "envelope-access-maintenance-safety-package"
description = "SSC-09 envelope access, maintenance, and safety metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound envelope access and maintenance safety metrics from a deterministic SSC-09 task-owned source pack. The template combines maintenance live load, support capacity, wind screen load, fall-arrest demand, access width, tolerance gap, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "structural"
category = "envelope-access-safety"
standards = ["maintenance access workflows", "fall arrest coordination", "envelope tolerance workflows"]
tags = ["structural", "envelope", "access", "maintenance", "fall-arrest", "wind", "tolerance", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.access_platform_area_m2]
type = "float"
unit = "m2"
description = "ACCESS-09-PLAN-03 access platform area"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.maintenance_live_load_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "LOAD-09-MAINT-03 maintenance live load"
min = 2.5
max = 2.5

[params.access_support_capacity_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "ANCH-09-ACCESS-03 access support capacity"
min = 55.0
max = 55.0

[params.wind_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "WIND-09-WEATHER-03 wind screen pressure"
min = 1.2
max = 1.2

[params.wind_screen_area_m2]
type = "float"
unit = "m2"
description = "WIND-09-WEATHER-03 exposed screen area"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.wind_anchor_capacity_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "ANCH-09-ACCESS-03 wind anchor capacity"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.fall_arrest_user_count]
type = "float"
description = "OPS-09-MAINT-03 fall-arrest user count"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.fall_arrest_load_kn_per_user]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "OPS-09-MAINT-03 fall-arrest load per user"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.fall_arrest_anchor_capacity_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "ANCH-09-ACCESS-03 fall-arrest anchor capacity"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.access_clear_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "ACCESS-09-PLAN-03 clear access width"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.required_access_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "OPS-09-MAINT-03 required access width"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.measured_tolerance_gap_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "LOAD-09-MAINT-03 measured tolerance gap"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.allowable_tolerance_gap_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "LOAD-09-MAINT-03 allowable tolerance gap"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[outputs.maintenance_live_load_kn]
description = "Maintenance live load on access platform"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.maintenance_load_margin_kn]
description = "Access support capacity minus maintenance live load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.wind_screen_load_kn]
description = "Wind load on exposed access screen"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.wind_anchor_margin_kn]
description = "Wind anchor capacity minus wind screen load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fall_arrest_demand_kn]
description = "Fall-arrest demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fall_arrest_margin_kn]
description = "Fall-arrest anchor capacity minus demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.access_width_margin_m]
description = "Clear access width minus required width"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.tolerance_margin_mm]
description = "Allowable tolerance gap minus measured gap"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when load, wind, fall-arrest, access, and tolerance checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
